notes: Pinky's second vault on Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). No token and no pool: PINKY (0xb125c461c00863aacad4cc99311d2f23d4342a6f) and PinkyStaking (0x17fb2067652bcf4803e937cf323a248ff6b7cba3) are already live from launch #1166, whose manifest is kept in launches/1166-launch.json, and the first vault PinkyVault (0x3c81384aa1ca064316576a214e2fb30969992772) stays live beside this one. PinkyVaultV2(owner_, imd_, staking_, intake_, action_, signer_, minBond_, panelSize_, quorum_, validForSeconds_) = ($owner, IMD on Robinhood Chain 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, the live PinkyStaking 0x17fb2067652bcf4803e937cf323a248ff6b7cba3, the IdentityMD Intake version 2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82, bytes32("oracle.request@oracle-1"), the oracle signer 0x5598aa9146215bc13eb26f2c692ad1461fd32982, minimum bond 5 IMD = 5000000000000000000, panel size 7, quorum 5, answers valid for 86400 seconds). The constructor stores these and calls no other contract; staking_ is also the first fee sink. A holder bonds IMD behind one of four promises about their own wallet: Keep (no more than amount of token sent out: log-sum of Transfer filtered on from), Pay (at least amount sent to target: log-sum filtered on from and to), Hold (balanceOf(maker) at least amount at the closing block: call-compare, bool answer) or Moves (no more than amount transfers out: log-count filtered on from, meant for NFTs). A promise may name a beneficiary. Settlement is two steps, both by settle (or close then ask). First the term is closed: the maker may close from the deadline, anyone else two minutes later, and the judged window runs from the make block to the closing block itself. Then, 32 blocks later, anyone asks: the vault pays the Intake's current price from the bond for one oracle.request over that exact window through requestWithFailure, recording the signer, panel and quorum it was bought under. The Intake calls back onOracleResult with the signed attestation, verified in the vault's own EIP-712 domain against the chain id, both block numbers, the recorded panel and quorum, agreed >= quorum and the recorded or current signer, or onOracleFailure on a refusal or a panel that did not agree, which is unsigned, moves no funds and only lets anyone ask again at once. Neither callback moves funds. payout, by anyone: a kept promise returns the bond to the maker less 1%; a broken promise with a beneficiary pays the beneficiary the bond less 1%; a broken promise without one pays 10% to the first asker, unless that is the maker's own address, half the rest to PinkyStaking (burned when nobody is staked) and the rest to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD, with no fee. The 1% accrues in the vault and anyone sends it to the fee sink with sendFees, which keeps it when the sink refuses. With no answer, ask may be repeated after a day or at once after a failure report, three times in all; once the refund is due only the maker or the beneficiary may ask again. After the third attempt, or seven days after closing, the rest is refunded to the maker with no fee. The owner comes from the request's owner field via $owner. It moves no funds directly and may only propose a new Intake and action (the Intake must have code), signer, panel or fee sink, each applied by anyone after seven days, and cancel a proposal; a proposal applies to promises still open at the enact, so an owner who, after seven days' public notice, enacts a signer and Intake of its own decides the verdicts of promises then open. IMD, PinkyStaking and the minimum bond are immutable. No initialization calls.
